newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - gas oil and gasoline dip, fuel.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil and gasoline dip, fuel.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday, traders said.
Gas oil dipped in line with a $1.75 a tonne slide in benchmark futures, but physical traders were at a stand-off waiting for screen levels to settle.
Fuel oil barges gained $1 to $84/$86 a tonne fob as post-holiday bunker demand pushed business along. Low sulphur cargo prices were steady.
Gasoline eased slightly in line with lower crude with Eurograde barges trading at $207 and $207.25 fob AR. Naphtha also eased with June paper assessed at $190.50/$191.50.
